answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 13663 Country: India Title: Assalamalaikum, Which Dua is good for relieving Bank credit? Question: Assalamalaikum, Which Dua is good for relieving Bank credit? Answer ID: 13663 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 944/944=M/1430) Recite the following dua after every salah and in the morning and evening: أللھم أکفني بحلالک عن حرامک وأغنني بفضلک عمن سواک Also, keep on looking for ways to repay the debt. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
